Discover and Split Homogeneous DICOM Sub-Series

Source: R/volume-read.R
dicom_split_series.Rd

Scans a directory or vector of DICOM file paths and partitions image files into homogeneous volumetric sub-series grouped by SeriesInstanceUID, Modality, SOPClassUID, matrix dimensions (Rows, Columns), rounded ImageOrientationPatient direction cosines, EchoNumbers, and localizer status (LOCALIZER / SCOUT). Primary 3D volumetric stacks are ordered ahead of scout/localizer slices, and multi-echo acquisitions are ordered by ascending echo number.

Usage

dicom_split_series(path, recursive = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Directory path or character vector of DICOM file/directory paths.

recursive

Logical. When path includes directories, search subdirectories recursively. Default is TRUE.

Value

A tibble::tibble with one row per discovered homogeneous sub-series and columns series_uid, subseries_id, modality, rows, cols, n_files, n_frames, orientation_key, echo_number, is_localizer, and files (list-column of normalized file path vectors).

Examples

out_dir <- tempfile("split_demo_")
dicom_synthesize(out_dir = out_dir, modality = "CT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 4L), mixed_series = TRUE)
dicom_split_series(out_dir)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 11
#>   series_uid  subseries_id modality  rows  cols n_files n_frames orientation_key
#>   <chr>              <int> <chr>    <int> <int>   <int>    <int> <chr>          
#> 1 2.25.17946…            1 CT          16    16       4        4 "1.000\\0.000\…
#> 2 2.25.17946…            2 CT          24    24       1        1 "0.000\\1.000\…
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: echo_number <chr>, is_localizer <lgl>, files <list>
unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
